content:
Failing test (the fixer must place it in forge/src/kani.rs mod tests — the symbols classify_l2_outcome/L2Result/is_under_bound_failure are private to the binary-only forge crate) supplied at forge/tests/divergence_degrade_oq2_pending.rs.pending.

DIVERGENCE: forge/src/kani.rs `is_under_bound_failure` — second arm `d.contains("unwind")` is a bare-substring match on the user's ens clause text, which kani echoes verbatim into `Failed Checks:` (parse_failed_checks). A REAL L2 counterexample whose ens text contains the substring 'unwind' (e.g. spec helper unwind_count, field .unwind, rewind, unwound) → classify_l2_outcome returns UnderBound → run_ladder degrades the DISPROVED contract to L1 with a lowered-assurance stamp. This hides a real bug behind a certified rung — the R-DEFER-9 / REQ-2 anti-cheat failure OQ-2 calls 'the sharpest hole'.

AUTHORITY: .design/forge/degrade-ladder.md OQ-2 — 'a concrete Failed Checks: assertion failed: <ens clause> = counterexample; unwinding assertion loop N = under-bound/inconclusive'; ratified resolution favors R-DEFER-9 (ambiguous → Counterexample). The under-bound discriminator must be kani's boilerplate 'unwinding assertion' ONLY.

CONFIRMED deterministically (faithful copy of 2323dcb logic): input 'assertion failed: result == unwind_count(n)' → UnderBound (WRONG); control 'assertion failed: result == spec_sum(xs)' → Counterexample (right).

EXPECTED FIX: drop the `|| d.contains("unwind")` arm; key on `unwinding assertion` only.

Note: a binary-only crate has no external pin for a private fn; the test belongs inside kani.rs alongside the one-line fix (the critic cannot Edit production code).
